title: EVS System: How to Register a New Vehicle Sticker
excerpt: Step-by-step guide to registering new vehicle stickers in the Electronic Vehicle Sticker system.
content:
Full guide:
1. Log into the EVS portal at evs.santech.rw
2. Navigate to Sticker Registration
3. Enter vehicle plate number and owner details
4. Upload required documents (vehicle card, owner ID)
5. Review and submit the application
6. Print the generated sticker approval

For bulk registration, use the CSV import feature under Tools > Bulk Import.
author: System Admin

title: SANTRACK: Adding a New Vehicle to Fleet
excerpt: Learn how to add a vehicle to SANTRACK GPS fleet management and configure tracking parameters.
content:
To add a vehicle:
1. Open SANTRACK dashboard
2. Go to Fleet > Add Vehicle
3. Enter vehicle registration, make, model, year
4. Assign GPS device serial number
5. Set geofence zones if applicable
6. Save and activate tracking

Note: Ensure the GPS device has a valid SIM card with data plan before activating.
author: Frank Kagabo

title: Understanding Your Invoice and Payment Schedule
excerpt: A guide to reading Santech invoices, understanding payment terms, and making payments.
content:
Invoice sections explained:
- Invoice Number: unique reference (e.g. INV-2026-001)
- Issue Date: when the invoice was generated
- Due Date: payment must be received by this date
- Line Items: detailed breakdown of services/products
- Subtotal, VAT (18%), and Total

Payment methods accepted: Bank Transfer (BK Rwanda), Mobile Money (MTN/Airtel), Cheque.
For payment queries contact finance@santech.rw
author: David Habimana

title: HR Policy: Annual Leave Entitlement and Application
excerpt: How to apply for annual leave, entitlement days, and approval workflow in the BMS system.
content:
Leave Entitlement:
- Permanent employees: 18 working days per year
- Probation employees: 1.5 days per completed month

Application process:
1. Go to Team > Attendance & Leave
2. Click Request Leave
3. Select leave type: Annual / Sick / Maternity / Paternity / Emergency
4. Enter start and end dates
5. Add reason/notes
6. Submit for manager approval

Approval flow: Employee → Line Manager → HR → Approved.
author: HR Manager

title: Website Maintenance: Content Update Guide
excerpt: How to update content on Santech-built WordPress and custom websites for our clients.
content:
For WordPress clients:
1. Access WP Admin at yourdomain.com/wp-admin
2. Use your provided credentials
3. Navigate to Pages or Posts to edit content
4. Use the block editor to modify text, images, and sections
5. Click Update to publish changes

For custom-built sites, submit a content change request to support@santech.rw with the specific page URL and new content.
author: Frank Kagabo

title: REVIXSAN: Running Your First Financial Report
excerpt: Generate profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash flow reports using REVIXSAN accounting module.
content:
To generate a P&L report:
1. Login to REVIXSAN
2. Go to Reports > Financial Statements
3. Select Report Type: Profit & Loss
4. Set the date range (e.g. Jan–Dec 2026)
5. Choose comparison period if needed
6. Click Generate Report
7. Export as PDF or Excel

Tip: Run monthly P&L to track revenue vs expenses trends early.
author: David Habimana

title: General IT: Password Security Best Practices
excerpt: Tips for creating strong passwords and securing your Santech BMS account.
content:
Password guidelines:
- Minimum 8 characters
- Mix uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
- Do not reuse passwords across systems
- Change your password every 90 days
- Enable two-factor authentication when available

If you forget your password, click Forgot Password on the login page or contact IT support at support@santech.rw.
author: System Admin

title: EVS System: Troubleshooting Sticker Printing Issues
excerpt: Common EVS sticker printing errors and how to resolve them quickly.
content:
Common issues and fixes:

1. Sticker not printing:
   - Ensure printer is set as default
   - Check that PDF viewer is installed
   - Try downloading the sticker PDF and printing manually

2. Barcode not scanning:
   - Ensure print quality is set to High
   - Check for ink levels
   - Reprint from a different browser

3. Wrong vehicle data on sticker:
   - Do not reprint — contact EVS support immediately at evs@santech.rw

For unresolved issues call +250 788 000 000.
author: System Admin
